# g23 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 9
- **Domain**: 0 ≤ x_i ≤ 10 for i = 1, ..., 9

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = 9 \sum_{i=1}^9 x_i
```

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = - \sum_{i=1}^9 x_i + 1 \leq 0
```
```math
g_2(x) = \sum_{i=1}^9 x_i^2 - 1/3 \leq 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = -400.055100
